title: test({angular,vue,solid}-query/queryOptions): add type tests for an optional 'initialData' object
body:
## 🎯 Changes

Adds a `should allow optional initialData object` type test to the `queryOptions` type tests of `angular-query-experimental`, `vue-query`, and `solid-query`. It checks that `queryOptions` accepts an `initialData` object that may be `undefined` (`Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'initial string' : undefined`) and that `options.initialData` extends `InitialDataFunction<string> | string | undefined`.

`react-query` and `preact-query` already have this test for `queryOptions`; these three packages had no equivalent, so nothing covered this case there.

Tests only; no source changes.
